title: Choose the scalar representation for complex arithmetic
goal: Rotate complex measurements using a chosen floating-point representation instead of always storing real and imaginary parts as double.

selectionNotes: Complex<T> requires IFloatingPointIeee754<T> and IMinMaxValue<T>; System.Decimal does not meet those constraints.
Existing Complex also changes some special-value results on .NET 11; generic storage is a separate choice.
